record.question: Which of the following is true of Symbolic Interactionism?
options: People following norms and traditions of interaction is the reason society exists.
It takes a wholesome look at society from a macro perspective.
An action or behaviour is considered good or bad only depending upon its reaction.
What is "real" is defined only through science and not through individual perception.
